# tenure standpoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureStandpoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The standpoint whose position a standpoint-tenure records. When a [`StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) generates a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) observation, the [`tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md) becomes the vantage of the claim.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md) from [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md), [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single standpoint whose position a [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) records — the frame that becomes the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) of the generated [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the position held (that is [`gmeow:tenurePosition`](gmeow-tenurePosition.md)) and avoid assigning two standpoints to one tenure — it is functional, exactly one frame per tenure; a different frame's position is a separate tenure, never a privileged primary one ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Point the tenure at one [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md); it surfaces as the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) of the generated [`gmeow:standpointClaim`](gmeow-standpointClaim.md), so generic consumers read 'whose frame' uniformly across tenures and bare observations.

### Examples

- ex:recognition [`gmeow:tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md) ex:stateA.
